Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

payin_flat_fee.description: Flat fee charged on each payin, in cents: 200 means 2.00. Maximum 100000 (1,000.00).

payin_percentage_fee.description: Basis points charged on each payin: 100 means 1%. Maximum 9900 (99%).

payout_flat_fee.description: Flat fee charged on each payout, in cents: 200 means 2.00. Maximum 100000 (1,000.00).

payout_percentage_fee.description: Basis points charged on each payout: 100 means 1%. Maximum 9900 (99%).
